content: Akaar bàyikyeenà a Yɛsu
Yàkäl naa ungö a an'taaŋ, Yɛsu kàkyen uboo a an'bul a kölàköl anà an'bul ikikye ntɔn mulɔŋ anà mupay làsaŋ a Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ yà Imwol a Nzam, alɔŋki bàkwem aŋiyweel bàkäl anà nde
anà akaar amwɛy kàkɔɔr nde unsà an'dweelà an'be anà an'kyal mà ifà ifà: Màlye bàfabeelà un'nsi Magàdala, uboo ande insɔŋà nsambwaar myàtoo,
Zyan, un'kyay a Shuzà mbuur a isal a Ɛlɔdi, Suzan, anà akaar asin bàyibayà Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande unsà indiir aba.
Nsim a un'köön
Baar mbɔɔn bàfü an'bul a kölàköl bàyàköŋ apà Yɛsu. Nde katɛɛl nsim yi:
« Un'köön mwɛy kàtoo mukàkɔn mbɛŋ ande. Umpal kàmwɛŋ nde ya, yar làmwɛy làbü u mbwo: baar bàndyaar ya, nɛn a du waa yàdi ya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü udu a nkɔŋ: mpal yàmɛn ya, bite laa byàyöm bya, ntɔn mɛɛn màkäl màŋàyɔm.
Yar lumwɛy làbü uboo a nsyeenà: nsyeenà yàyɛl mbwo mwɛy anà in'te, waa yàfwee mya.
Yar lumwɛy làbü u mɛn aŋàbwaŋ: mpal làyɛl la, la làbör mbɛŋ mbɔɔn: imbɛŋ mwɛy kyàbör mbɛŋ nkam anà nkam. » Yɛsu waa kàkwɛy abà: « Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü awem uwem. »
Ntɔn nkye Yɛsu ufàsyääl nde nsim
Alɔŋki ande bun'fuul naa nsim ayi iswaŋà aben.
Nde kafuur naa: « Bweel a bɛ là naa bɛ làkyàyöb ngyee a imwol a Nzam, wɛ akà baar bumwɛy, ndaa ayi bàfakyään unsà nsim. Ntɔn,

content.text: "itàkal naa ba bàkyer aleerà, ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n aman,
"itàkal naa ba bàkyer aweemà, ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb." »

content: Yɛsu wàmubuul nsim a un'köön
« Mpalàbà làwem mbuul a nsim ayi: Mbɛŋ yà ndaa a Nzam.
Kɔl a mbwo, là baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ Satanà waa uyàlwom ya u mpem aba ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n asà làkwikilà anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n awà möö.

Udu a nkɔŋ yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàwal ya unsà un'sak, wɛɛ ba ya bàfàkaar anki u mpem aba, làkwikilà aba bwɛl latɛy. La in'swɛy myatɛy, isàkal naa mpay yan'yà, ba ban'piy làkwikilà aba.
Mbɛŋ yàbü u nsyeenà yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam, wɛɛ ba ya bàfàküünà a mpay anà ngyal a indiir a mɛɛn. Abun ya ifàbɔr anki mbɛŋ.
Mbɛŋ yàbü u mɛn aŋàbwaŋ yà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàwal ya unsà un'sak, bàfàkaar ya u mpem aba anà bàfàsyääl ya. Ya ifàbɔr mbɛŋ. »
Nsim a mwinà
Yɛsu kàläb abà: « Akà mbuur mwey ukwe anki mukyä mwinà waa ukümà wa kantin, itàkal usi wa ungyɛl a itäb. Wɛɛ nde wa asà udu a ikɔlà a un'te ntɔn baar bàbilà u ndwà bàmɛn pɛɛlà.
Undiir wanswà wàŋàyee ŋàbawà, akyer asàmɛnà u pɛɛlà. Undiir wanswà wà unku, baar bàkyer asàyöb wa, wa sye asàmɛnà u leŋ.
Làlɛɛ an'tsü abɛ ntɔn muwem ubwaŋàbwaŋ, ntɔn bàsàkwɛy akà mbuur awe anà undiir, wɛ akà mbuur mpa awe anà undiir bàsàlwom undiir ufàsi nde naa nde we anà wa. »
Ngwän anà atɔŋ a Yɛsu
Yàmɛnà naa ngwän anà atɔŋ a Yɛsu bàyi muyàbwey anà nde, wɛɛ yàkäl mpay ba mukun'man ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn.
Baar bun'kyään naa: « Ngwa anà atɔŋ angye bà unsà, ba bàkwen mukaman. »
Nde kafuur naa: « Maa anà atɔŋ amɛ bà baar bàfàwem ndaa a Nzam anà bàfàsyääl ya. »
Yɛsu kan'kwaam un'pöb
Yàlɔ̈m naa ilä mwɛy, Yɛsu kàbilà u bwaar a kölàköl anà alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Tsweenà bi isabà sim a ɛwà. » Ba waa bàkyen.
Mpal bàkäl ba mubweel, Yɛsu waa kàbɔ̈ɔ̈n. Kà imbürà, un'pöb a ngwal kàyi udu a ɛwà. An'dà waa màsɛmà mubilà u bwaar, ba bàkäl u mpay a ukwà.

Alɔŋki bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bun'wiy anà in'kwɛŋ u mun: « Un'lɔɔŋ, Un'lɔɔŋ, bi abà ikwà! » Nde waa usubà, waa uŋän un'pöb anà ibɔ a kölàköl byà an'dà: bya waa byàkwamà, duu waa làbilà.

Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Làkwikilà abɛ làken? » Wɛɛ ba bàkäl u bɔɔmà anà unsà ubem, ba bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Baal awà wà nà? Nde wàmuŋän un'pöb anà ibɔ a an'dà, bya sye byàmukun'weemà. »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr baal kàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be
Ba bàkɔlà u mɛɛn a Ngɛlàsà u sim a Ngalilɛ.

Pa kàtɔ̈l Yɛsu làkɔl u mɛɛn, mbuur mwɛy wà bul alan kàkäl anà insɔŋà mbɔɔn, nde kàyi akà Yɛsu. Sɛmà itaan nde kàkälà nsàpɔl. Nde kàkweenà anki mukal u ndwà, nde kàfabwaayà uboboo a an'dii.
Mpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kabü kà in'kɔl ande, waa kàlal in'kwɛŋ mutɛn u ndaa a ngwal naa: « Yɛsu, Mwan a Nzam a Dudu, mɛ anà ngye un'tüüb nà? Mɛ amabɔɔn, twon aman'pà mpay. »

Yɛsu waa kàböŋ insɔŋà myàkäl uboo a mbuur awà. Ntɔn mya myun'bilà itaan. Ba bàfun'bäämà an'dwaaŋ anà impaaŋ a in'te kà an'kɔɔ anà kà in'kɔl ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n atiin. Wɛɛ nde kàkyer afatsuulà mya myanswà, insɔŋà myun'syeenà u nsye a ipɔl.
Yɛsu waa kun'fuul naa: « Ikɔb angye nà? » Nde kàfuur naa: « Un'kàbɔ. » Ntɔn insɔŋà mbɔɔn myàbilà amu ande.
Insɔŋà amin myàbɔ̈ɔ̈n Yɛsu naa nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akatɔm uboo a un'baan.
Wɛɛ tsütsü apan làkäl anà làböl a ngul làmuyidyà udu a mɔŋ, lalan myàlɔ̈m mya akà Yɛsu naa mya myàbilà uboo a ngul. Nde waa kapɛ mbwo.
Apan, insɔŋà myàtoo mya unsà mbuur awun, mya myàbilà u ngul ayin, làböl a ngul waa làparà ntiin fà iköl a mɔŋ, laa làkàbwà la kà an'dà, waa làminà.
Aseey bàmɛn ba abun, laa bàtiin ba, bàkyen ba mukàpay làsaŋ kà an'bul anà kà itsuŋ a ndwà.
Baar bàyi ntɔn muyöb naa ya yàlyaaŋ aben. Mpal bàyàtol ba tsütsü apà Yɛsu, bàmɛn ba ŋukɔŋ akyàbwaay kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, akyàbwaar, akyàkal a duu, ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà.
Baar bàkäl paa mpal kàkɔɔr nde ŋukɔŋ, bàkyäänà baar naa nde kun'kɔɔr aben.
Kyakin baar a Ngɛlàsa banswà bàkäl ba u bɔɔmà, waa bàlɔ̈m akà Yɛsu mulwomà apà ba. Nde kàbilà u bwaar ntɔn mufurà.
Mbuur awà kàkɔɔrà unsà an'dweelà an'be kàlɔ̈m akà Yɛsu naa nde uyilyaaŋ anà nde, wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa:
« Furà ndwà angye, kyen kakyään ndaa yanswà kan'kyer Nzam akà ngye. » Lalan mbuur awà kàkàpay nde làsaŋ a ndaa yanswà kàkyer Yɛsu akà nde u bul lanswà.
Mwan a Zayirɔs wà un'kaar anà un'kaar kàbä Yɛsu kà ipfɛy
Mpal kàfurà Yɛsu Ngalilɛ, baar banswà bun'wɛl unsà ubwaŋ banswà, ntɔn ba bàkäl mukun'dilà.
Apan mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Zayirɔs laa kàyi nde. Nde kàkäl mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Nde kàbü kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde ukyen ndwà ande:
mwan ande mwɛy mpɛl wà un'kaar wà tsütsü mbul kwem aŋiyweel kàkäl musyäämà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Yɛsu waa kàkyen ndwà a mbuur awun. Apan, baar mbɔɔn bàyibääbà u mbil a ndür ande.
Uboo a baar aban kàkäl anà un'kaar mwɛy kàyimanà an'kil mbul kwem aŋiyweel. Nde kàdwä ngim mbɔɔn akà angaŋ, wɛɛ nde kàkɔɔra anki.
Nde kàsin tsütsü ungö a Yɛsu, waa kun'bä u làpan a ipfɛy ande. Taaŋ nsil alan an'kil laa màtsü ma mutoo.
Yɛsu waa kàfuul naa: « Nà kàman'ba? » Wɛɛ akà mbuur mwɛy kàkyey anki. Petɔlà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ambà Un'lɔɔŋ, baar bàmasà uboboo, bà mbɔɔn bà imbäm'dir anà ngye. »
Nde waa kàtɛn naa: « Mbuur akyer an'ba: mɛ in'kyer awem naa dweelà a ngwal mwɛy lan'too u ndür amɛ. »

Un'kaar awun kàmɛn nde naa undiir kàkyer nde kan'mɛnà u mii a baar, laa kàsin nde tsütsü apà Yɛsu, kàbü nde kà inkɔl ande, waa kàtɛn u mii a baar ntɔn nkye kun'bä nde anà muswaŋ naa taaŋ nsil alan nde waa kàkɔɔrà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mangwa, làkwikilà angye làmatswà mɔ̈ɔ̈, kyen unsà duu. »
Nde kàkäl anki aŋàtàmay mutɛn mpal kàyi mbuur kàfü ndwà a mfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Waa kun'kyään naa: « Mwan angye wà unkaar kan'kwà, twon afun'twääl Un'lɔɔŋ nkwom. »
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu abwɛy, nde kàtɛn a Zayirɔs naa: « Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sà làkwikilà mpɛl, mwan angye akyer akɔɔrà. »
Mpal kàkɔlà nde, Yɛsu kàkwen anki naa baar asin bàbilà u ndwà, wɛ Petɔlà, Ywan, Zyak, taar anà ngwän a mwan mpɛl.
Ntsü yanswà baar bàkäl mulel. Yɛsu waa kàtɛn naa: « Twon lan'lel, nde ukü anki, nde kan'bɔ̈ɔ̈n twaal. »
Wɛɛ ba bàkyer un'sɛɛ, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöbà naa nde kàkäl aŋàkwà.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛ kɔɔ a kimwan un'kaar awun mpi, waa kàtɛn a nde u ndaa a ngwal naa: « Mwan amɛ, wiyà! »
Laa kàwiyà nde, waa kàmbarà. Yɛsu kàswɛŋ naa ba bun'pɛ udyà.
Aböör a mwan un'kaar awun matɛɛr màkyer awal. Wɛɛ Yɛsu katsüŋ mukyään mbuur asin ndaa ayin.
